Auth.onboardingDescription: Our team will guide you through the platform, answer your questions, and help you get started with BAU AI.
Auth.tagline: Shaping the future of construction together with our community and AI agents.

Login.description: Sign in to continue to your BAU AI workspace.
Login.verifyFirst: Please verify your email. We have sent you a new verification link.
Login.error: Unable to sign in. Please try again.

SignUp.title: Create your account
SignUp.description: Create your login first. We will ask about your company after your email is verified.
SignUp.name: Full name
SignUp.validation: Enter your name, a valid email, and a password with at least 8 characters.
SignUp.error: Unable to create your account. Please try again.
SignUp.checkEmailDescription: We sent a verification link to {email}.
SignUp.checkSpam: The link is valid for one hour. Check your spam folder if it doesn't arrive shortly.

VerifyEmail.successDescription: You're all set. We're preparing your company onboarding now.
VerifyEmail.errorDescription: This verification link is invalid or has expired. Create your account again or request a new link.

Onboarding.title: Required for tender matching
Onboarding.description: Tell us about your company so we can prepare relevant tender matches. If the company already exists, you'll be added to its workspace.
Onboarding.websiteHint: We use the website domain to find or create your company workspace.
Onboarding.websiteError: Enter a valid public company website, such as www.mycompany.eu.
Onboarding.regionHint: Choose a Google suggestion for accurate coordinates, or confirm the typed region manually.
Onboarding.regionRequired: Select a suggestion or confirm the typed region.
Onboarding.servicesPlaceholder: Type a service or choose from the list...
Onboarding.servicesHint: Press Enter to add your own service, or select one from the dropdown.
Onboarding.servicesEmpty: No matching service. Press Enter to add it.
Onboarding.cpvHint: Review the AI suggestions, or search and add CPV codes manually.
Onboarding.cpvRequired: Add at least one CPV code.
Onboarding.cpvMapError: Unable to map CPV codes. Please select them manually.
Onboarding.trialTitle: Your 7-day free trial starts after onboarding
Onboarding.trialDescription: No credit card required. The first user in a new company becomes its administrator.
Onboarding.error: Unable to complete onboarding. Please try again.
Onboarding.pendingDescription: This company already exists. An administrator must approve your request before you can access its workspace.
Onboarding.completeDescription: Your company and seven-day trial have been configured.

Dashboard.chooseAgent: Choose your agent. Your workflow partner.
Dashboard.composerPlaceholder: Upload your document and get started.

patrick.description: Manage timelines, track progress, and coordinate tasks efficiently.

dora.description: Review contracts, flag risks, and extract requirements from your documents.

clara.description: Analyze tenders, compare bids, and streamline the procurement process.

dario.description: Coordinate logistics, track deliveries, and manage site resources.

nova.description: Evaluate every bid automatically, extract key data, and score readiness.

Dashboard.pendingDescription: Your request has been sent to the company administrators. You will gain workspace access after one of them approves it.
Dashboard.rejectedDescription: A company administrator declined your membership request. Contact your company administrator if you believe this was a mistake.

membershipRequests.title: Membership requests
membershipRequests.description: Approve only people who should have access to your company workspace.
